headline: Mercy Reignites as Hollow, Berm and Expanse Trade Blows
war_summary: Since the last edition the busiest wire has turned over again, with Linn Mercy reporting eight changes in two hours and thirty-four in the day about Outwich Ranch and Lathair, standing ten Colonial and one neutral, after showing no movement in the prior two-hour window. Palantine Berm remains fast with four changes in two hours and sixty-one in the day about Vendett, Windburn Landing and the Pippeli Stones, now three Warden to four Colonial. Marban Hollow adds four in two hours and thirty-one in the day centered on Checkpoint Bua, holding two Warden, three Colonial and three neutral with the latest report at the hour. Weathered Expanse counts five in two hours and thirty-one in the day at Spirit Watch, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk for six Warden and three neutral. Nevish Line shows three late changes and eleven in the day at Blinding Stones and Grief Mother. Stonecradle, Gutter and Farranac record no change in two hours, and Mooring County remains silent since the early morning, while heavy casualties without flips continue in Clahstra, Callum's Cape and Callahan's Passage.
